distribution.summary: Beijing; Fujian; Jiangxi; Yunnan; Hong Kong; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) documented Beijing, Fujian, Jiangxi, Yunnan, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) reported Taiwan under the historical name Cyclorhipidion fukiensis; its broad China (SE) wording does not establish a province. Lau (2025) separately listed Hong Kong, and Lin & Smith (2022) independently reported Taiwan.

host_note: Smith et al. (2020) reported Cyclobalanopsis glauca (= Quercus glauca); Beaver & Liu (2010) reported Quercus incana under the historical name Cyclorhipidion fukiensis. Lau (2025) and Lin & Smith (2022) provide geographic evidence only.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion distinguendum (Eggers, 1930).

nomenclature_note: Current accepted identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Cyclorhipidion distinguendum (Eggers, 1930), VSN_1987. Beaver & Liu (2010) used Cyclorhipidion fukiensis as a new combination and synonymized Xyleborus tenuigraphus with C. fukiensis; these source-specific names and actions are retained as provenance under the current stable identity.
